Geometry refusal and precommit cancellation leave operative state unchanged; interruption after sealing reports a durable committed transition.
State seals, held-clone independence, delayed generated-status visibility, exact fresh replay and versioned history/frame export.

closed_findings: Removed silent omission of the parked moving-tool envelope during the second withdrawal.
Added cancellation check after geometry and durable postcommit interruption handling.
Replaced the superficial free-approach positive fixture with a full-tool hold inside an explicit generated tunnel.
Replaced ambiguous retained=false output with retained_at_depth, exact pose_status and physical_absence_claim=false; both final access poses remain recorded.

limitations: Generated software/geometry continuity only; inspection status changes visible status and STOP reason but does not change the physical decision sequence. Package 2 is incomplete.
The second tool is preset in the initial state; its insertion is not simulated.
Withdrawal returns to recorded access poses, not proven physical absence. Consumers must preserve those poses.
Independent motion checking covers tissue and access only. Tool-tool clearance uses the primary checker, not an independent pair checker.
Fresh replay authenticates the same implementation and source. Legacy native metrics/history evaluators are not passive-episode authority.
A refused required motion leaves a failed fixed episode; this is not a general controller with a fallback action.
Generated durations are not measured operative time. No sensor accuracy, injury, physiology, clinical, patient, policy-learning or desktop admission claim.
